editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood Thai gem serving authentic northern Thai cuisine with warm hospitality and consistently delicious, generously portioned dishes.
editorial.insiderTip: Go in the evening or late-night for the full experience, and order the Hang Ley alongside classics like Pad Thai or Pad Khee Mao—the portions are massive and prices hover around $25 per person with an appetizer, main, and drink.
